short.en: How many ways can a sentence be read?

t.zh: 「咬死了猎人的狗」：是狗咬死了猎人，还是猎人的狗被咬死了？同一串词，两两合并成短语的方式不同，意思就不同。合并的过程画出来，就是一棵句法树。
t.en: “Old men and women”: are the women old too, or only the men? The same words, merged into phrases two at a time in different ways, mean different things: (old men) and women, or old (men and women). Draw the merging out and you get a parse tree.

t.zh: 假设任何两段相邻的词都能合并。一串词一共有几种不同的合并方式？还是区间表：格子 (i, j) 记「第 i 到第 j 个词有几种合并方式」。单个词只有 1 种，对角线已经填好。
t.en: Suppose any two neighbouring stretches of words can be merged. How many different ways are there to merge a run of words? An interval table again: cell (i, j) records “how many ways words i to j can be merged”. A single word has just 1, so the diagonal is already filled in.

t.zh: 最后一次合并，把左边一段和右边一段合起来。在某个切分点，左边有几种方式、右边有几种方式，两边可以随便搭配：这个切分点一共有几种？不同的切分点之间，又该怎么合起来？
t.en: The last merge joins a left stretch and a right stretch. At a given split point, the left side has some number of ways and the right side some number, and any left way can go with any right way: how many ways does this split point give? And how should the different split points be combined?

t.zh: 合并石子时，每个切分点是「左 + 右」，再挑最省的。这里呢？扫帚的扫描臂照样按切分点送来左段们和右段们，乘法器也能一对一对地乘。
t.en: When merging stones, each split point was “left + right”, and you picked the cheapest. What about here? Broom’s sweep arm sends the left parts and right parts by split point as before, and a Multiplier can multiply them pair by pair too.

goal.zh: 一串词两两合并成短语，直到合成一整句。算出一共有几种不同的合并方式（几棵句法树）。
goal.en: A run of words is merged two at a time into phrases until it becomes one whole sentence. Work out how many different ways of merging there are (how many parse trees).

how.zh: 扫描臂送来每个切分点的左段和右段。
how.en: The sweep arm sends the left part and right part for every split point.

body.zh: 3 个词 2 种，4 个词 5 种，5 个词 14 种：这串数叫卡特兰数，词一多就飞快地变大。所以电脑分析句子时，不会把每一棵树都列出来，而是用这张区间表一格一格地算。
body.en: 3 words, 2 ways; 4 words, 5; 5 words, 14: these are the Catalan numbers, and they grow very fast as words are added. That is why a computer analysing a sentence doesn’t list every tree, but works through this interval table cell by cell.

body.zh: 真正的句法分析（叫 CKY 算法）还会查语法规则：哪两段能合并、合成什么。表的形状一模一样。
body.en: Real parsing (the CKY algorithm) also checks grammar rules: which two stretches can merge, and into what. The table has exactly the same shape.

note.zh: 句法树：每个切分点「左 × 右」，再加起来。
note.en: Parse trees: “left × right” at each split point, then add them up.

hints.zh: 先只看一个切分点：左边的每一种方式，都能和右边的每一种搭配。这样一共有几种？
hints.en: Look at a single split point first: every way on the left can go with every way on the right. How many is that in all?

hints.zh: 所有切分点的结果都算数：接进「加起来」。
hints.en: Every split point’s result counts: wire them into “sum”.
